Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs
Sponsor: Drake
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 225 as introduced could increase the financial and administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Veterans Affairs, by an undetermined amount, subject to approval by the State Board of Veterans' Affairs, to educate, recognize and promote the mission of the State Board of Veterans' Affairs to veterans, the public, and other public agencies. This bill also clarifies the expenses that must be paid by the counties to maintain a county service commissioner office.
Dickie Drake, Chair
Military and Veterans Affairs
